protocol.bond_perception: OpenBabel ConnectTheDots + PerceiveBondOrders; zero total charge and default electron-parity spin; centered PDB serialization as in Pymatgen BabelMolAdaptor
protocol.valid: RDKit PDB load/sanitization with removeHs=True and canonical isomeric SMILES conversion
protocol.valid_connected: Valid and one connected component; denominator all generated samples
protocol.uniqueness: Distinct canonical isomeric SMILES of largest component among valid samples / valid samples
